description: The bar chart compares the ratio of knowledge popularity among three different language models: Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT, across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the ratio, labeled as "Ratio (%)", and is measured on a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90. The horizontal axis lists the categories, which are Movies, Songs, and Basketball. In the Movies category, Llama3 has the highest ratio, close to 90%, followed by Qwen2, which is slightly lower, and ChatGPT, which has the lowest ratio, around 70%. In the Songs category, Qwen2 has the highest ratio, slightly above 80%, with Llama3 and ChatGPT following, both around 70%. In the Basketball category, Llama3 has the highest ratio, close to 60%, with Qwen2 and ChatGPT following, both around 50%. The bars are color-coded with Llama3 in blue, Qwen2 in red, and ChatGPT in yellow. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
